attacks.name: Stabby Swords
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Gwenpool‘s Bag of Tricks
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|!wild| |!hit| |*Gwenpool Special|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§incinerate§Incinerate|, |§poison§Poison|, or |§shock§Shock|.

attacks.name: This End Toward Target
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.
|!wild| |*Scorched Earth|: Before |!damage| is dealt, all other characters within |!range| 2 of the defender suffer 1 |!damage| and gain the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: Travel Through Gutter Space
superPowers.body: This character drops all objective tokens it is holding. Then Place this character within |!range| 3 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Retcon Powers Activate!
superPowers.body: While this character is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, it may spend up to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each 1 |!power| spent, this character may reroll one of its attack or defense dice. This superpower may be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Plot Armor
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
